sources.title: José Manuel López (footballer) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: José Manuel Alberto López (born 6 December 2000), also known as Flaco López, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Palmeiras and the Argentina national team.

sources.snippet: Coca-Cola Bottling Plant** Tiny miniature workers in red and white uniforms with the **Coca-Cola logo** on their hats are bustling around a Coca-Cola bottling plant. They are operating tiny bottling machines, filling miniature glass bottles with fizzy Coca-Cola, and sealing them with caps. Each bottle prominently displays the **Coca-Cola logo**.

sources.title: GitHub - zzowenzz/COCO_Tiny
sources.snippet: The Tiny COCO Dataset is a subset of the full COCO dataset and has been structured to provide immediate access to a smaller, more manageable collection of images across all categories. This is ideal for: Rapid Prototyping: Quickly test and debug models without the overhead of working with tens of gigabytes of data.
